description: Create a game in the signed-in workspace. Returns its client token (gl_pub_…, the public key game builds send with) and the intake URL to put in the game's Glitchless.init; the instrument skill says where for each engine. Later calls can name it with game. With demo: true it makes the demo game instead: Zoomies with a week of sample play (findings, levels, errors, sessions and a dashboard), for trying every tool before a real game sends data. A workspace has one demo game, and it takes no room from the plan's games. With rename (and game naming which one), renames a game instead, as players know it (a jam game renamed before release): the dashboard, share links and emails show the new name, and its client token, its service (what the game sends as service in Glitchless.init) and its data stay as they are, so the game's code needn't change. Later calls name it by its new name. Ask the person before renaming their game.

demo.description: Make the demo game, with a week of sample play

game.description: The game, by name or id, when signed in to a workspace (glitchless_list_games lists them); later calls keep it. With a key for one game (gl_sk_…), a call that names another game is refused: sign in to the workspace to reach every game.

name.description: The game's name, as players know it (not needed with demo)

rename.description: Instead of making a game: the new name (60 characters at most) of the game that game names

name: glitchless_create_game
title: Create or rename game
